svg.title: Three services loading their own pub/sub component configuration, all pointing at one broker
svg.desc: Three dashed bands side by side. The left, captioned Publish, holds a green hexagon named Cart joined to a hexagon carrying the Dapr logo. The middle, captioned Pub/sub components, lists four marks with their names: Redis, NATS, Azure Service Bus and RabbitMQ. The right, captioned Subscribe, holds two rows, each a Dapr sidecar joined to a service hexagon, named Shipping and Email. An arrow runs from the cart sidecar into the components band, and from there to each subscriber sidecar. Under each of the three sidecars is a cogs mark named Component configuration.
